en.headline: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The five-day event, expected to draw over 45,000 participants from more than 120 economies, begins on Monday with the main conference at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.
body: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 opened on Monday and runs through Friday. The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau and Invest Hong Kong said the programme would focus on financial empowerment, technological innovation and global expansion.

The main conference is held on 2 and 3 November at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai. Additional community and networking events are scheduled across the city and the Greater Bay Area. Organisers said they expected more than 45,000 participants from over 120 economies, more than 1,000 speakers, and over 800 exhibitors and start-ups, plus more than 30 delegations from the mainland and overseas.

Chief Executive John Lee and Financial Secretary Paul Chan are among the speakers listed by organisers. The agenda includes specialised forums covering artificial intelligence, digital assets and Web3, green technology, insurtech, and start-up ventures.

The event marks the period of the national 15th Five-Year Plan and Hong Kong's first five-year plan for economic and social development. Further details are available through the official channels of the organisers.

zh.headline: 香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK今日開幕
zh.dek: 為期五日的活動預計吸引來自超過120個經濟體逾4.5萬名與會者，主論壇周一在香港會議展覽中心展開。
body: 香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK 2026周一開幕，持續至周五。財經事務及庫務局與投資推廣署表示，活動聚焦金融賦能、科技創新及全球拓展。
主論壇於11月2及3日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行。另有社區及交流活動於全港及大灣區其他場地進行。主辦單位指，預計吸引來自超過120個經濟體逾4.5萬名與會者、超過1000名演講嘉賓、800多家參展機構及初創企業，以及超過30個內地及海外代表團。
行政長官李家超及財政司司長陳茂波等列為演講嘉賓。議程包括人工智能、數字資產及Web3、綠色科技、保險科技及創業家等專題論壇。
活動適逢國家「十五五」規劃及香港首個五年規劃推進期間。詳情可向主辦單位官方渠道查詢。
